title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: 25. Calls for the development of common guidelines for programme evaluation reports in order to ensure the collection of better-quality data and more effective use of results in defining future priorities; calls for the evaluation of programme effectiveness to take into account not only indicators of visibility and recognisability, but also their contribution to expanding export potential, market uptake and to the maintenance of economic activity in rural areas; calls for the evaluations to also assess impacts on animal welfare, greenhouse gas emissions, land use and biodiversity; stresses the importance of transparency in EU co-funded promotional campaigns, ensuring that these are clearly identifiable as such, and that consumers receive accurate information; highlights, in this regard, the importance of labelling standards to ensure a level playing field and consumer protection; calls for strengthened action to tackle counterfeiting, misleading use of names and misuse of EU quality reputations abroad;
